answer: Duplicating identities forces attackers to fund fresh stakes and generate novel sonnets per fake agent, while colluding peers risk slashing, making mass sybil creation costlier than the rewards it could capture. Each agent must stake tokens and publish a unique signed sonnet as its identity proof; a rotating beacon broadcasts epoch challenges that agents answer with work verified through a prism of independent peer attestations. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
